name: K3s developer tools
description: Adds the tools for developing K3s on top of the build environment from the repository's Dockerfile (target: infra): an in-container Docker daemon, cgroup v2 setup to run K3s nested, helm, k9s, golangci-lint, delve, gopls, gotests, the Kubernetes MCP server and Claude Code. All downloads are pinned and checksum-verified.
